items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because, do you know Johnny Hyman, Johnny Wiggs? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that was one of them private songs.

ctx.x: Because, do you know Johnny Hyman, Johnny Wiggs? He used to be a student around, you know, and he'd go there. And he'd tell me about Happy Bolton singing all the songs over in the corner. Well, only the young men could listen and the ladies couldn't hear them.
Well, that was one of them private songs.
